name: lww-two-fields-shared-target
description: The register counterpart to append-two-fields-shared-target (WRIT-201). Two body fields, 'x' and 'y', are declared as lww rules sharing one target ('t') under one exact (op_type, op_version) envelope, and one operation writes both. Every matching rule applies (spec/fold.md §5), so both writes land on the same register within a single position of the total order L; spec/fold.md §5's canonical rule order — ascending (op_type, op_version, field) — decides which is treated as later, so 'y' writes after 'x' and the register settles on 'y-val'. As in the append vector, the harness-local labels sort into the reverse order, so an implementation ordering by its own rule slice rather than by rule content folds this to 'x-val' and fails.
